name: fal-image-gen
title_zh: 给电商创始人出图出片的 fal.ai 直连生成器
tagline_zh: 写文案时顺手把广告图、PDP 主图、节日海报和短视频一起生成出来，拿到的是能直接上传的成品文件，不是一段描述。
tagline_en: While you write copy, it also renders the ad creative, PDP hero, festive poster and short reel — real files you.
desc_en: Generate real images and short videos via fal.ai. Use when the founder needs a shippable asset (ad creative, PDP hero, reel, packaging mockup, festive poster) rather than a described one. Triggers on phrases like "generate an image", "make me a creative", "draw a hero shot", "render the ad", "generate a video", "animate this", "make a reel". Optional add-on: needs a fal.ai key. Without one it hand
why_zh: 直接调 fal.ai 出图出片，产物是文件不是提示词。创始人要的是能上架的素材，这一步它替你走完了。
why_en: Calls fal.ai directly and returns files, not prompts. It finishes the last mile founders actually need: a shippable asset.
limit_zh: 必须自备 fal.ai API key，没有 key 只能停在配置引导；只产出图片和短视频素材，不写投放文案。
limit_en: Requires your own fal.ai API key — without it you stop at setup. Outputs images and short video assets only: no ad copy, no A/B testing, no.
title_en: fal.ai generator that ships real ad images and reels
